# CurioVault

> CurioVault is an authoritative digital archive and publication exploring fascinating untold human stories, bizarre history, earth anomalies, and mind-blowing scientific phenomena, paired with documentary video features.

## Featured Curated Articles

- [The 2,000-Year-Old Analog Computer That Baffled Modern Science](https://curiovault.pages.dev/blog/antikythera-mechanism/): Investigation into the ancient Greek Antikythera Mechanism, an astronomical gear calculator 1,000 years ahead of its time.
- [The Sailing Stones of Death Valley](https://curiovault.pages.dev/blog/sailing-stones-death-valley/): How massive dolomite boulders glide across California's desert playa driven by thin ice sheets and wind.
- [The Lost Amber Room: The Eighth Wonder of the World That Vanished in WWII](https://curiovault.pages.dev/blog/the-lost-amber-room/): The mystery of the stolen Prussian-Russian amber chamber looted by Nazi troops in 1941.
- [The Voynich Manuscript: The 600-Year-Old Book Nobody Can Read](https://curiovault.pages.dev/blog/voynich-manuscript/): Analysis of the undeciphered 15th-century vellum codex written in an unknown cipher.
- [The Carrington Event of 1859](https://curiovault.pages.dev/blog/carrington-event-1859/): What happens when a monster solar coronal mass ejection strikes Earth's magnetosphere.
- [Mariana Trench: The Hadal Abyss & Creatures of the Challenger Deep](https://curiovault.pages.dev/blog/mariana-trench-abyss/): Exploring the deepest point on planet Earth under 1,000 atmospheres of crushing pressure.
